description:
Current state: 17 platform adapters have only stub-based smoke tests that verify
adapter wiring (method call order, SQL patterns) but cannot catch real issues like
SQL dialect incompatibility, auth failures, data type mismatches, or query execution
bugs. Only 3 platforms (Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks) have live integration tests,
and those never run in CI. LakeSail has zero CI coverage (no stub, only live tests
that skip without a running server).

Goal: Every platform adapter has real integration tests that execute actual queries
against a real database engine. Two tiers:

Tier 1 - Docker-local (8 platforms): ClickHouse (server mode), Trino, Presto,
PostgreSQL, StarRocks, Doris, Databend, InfluxDB. These can run locally via Docker
compose with no cloud credentials. Tests should be runnable with a single
`make test-docker-<platform>` command.

Tier 2 - Cloud-live (2 platforms): Redshift, Athena SQL. These require cloud
credentials and follow the existing Snowflake/BigQuery/Databricks live test
pattern with env-var gating.

Additionally: LakeSail needs a stub for CI coverage (matching all other platforms),
and existing Docker compose files (Doris, Databend) should be leveraged.

Note on PySpark: PySpark runs locally without Docker (JVM-based, no server needed).
It already has integration tests in tests/integration/test_dask_dataframe_integration.py
and the pyspark CI job. No additional Docker infrastructure required.

Note on LakeSail Docker: LakeSail requires the proprietary Sail server binary
(`sail serve`). There is no public Docker image. The stub (w3) provides CI coverage;
live testing requires manual setup with a Sail server license.

anti_patterns.instead: live tests should focus on real query execution, data loading, and result correctness, not re-test adapter wiring
anti_patterns.why: each adapter already has unit + stub tests

anti_patterns.dont: make Docker a hard requirement for running the test suite
anti_patterns.instead: Docker tests are opt-in via `make test-docker-*`
anti_patterns.why: developers must be able to run `make test-fast` without Docker

anti_patterns.dont: store credentials or secrets in docker-compose files
anti_patterns.instead: use environment variables with documented defaults for local dev
anti_patterns.why: compose files are committed to git

deferrals.reason: Requires GitHub Actions with Docker compose support (services or docker compose in workflow). Design after local Docker tests are proven stable. Could use scheduled runs (nightly) rather than per-PR.
deferrals.summary: CI pipeline for Docker-based integration tests

deferrals.reason: These Spark-on-cloud platforms require significant cloud infrastructure (clusters, IAM roles, S3/GCS staging). Lower priority - the Spark execution path is partially covered by PySpark/LakeSail local tests.
deferrals.summary: Athena Spark, EMR Serverless, GCP Dataproc live tests

deferrals.reason: ClickHouse server mode covers the query execution path. Cloud mode adds HTTPS transport + auth but the SQL layer is identical. Add when ClickHouse Cloud credentials are available.
deferrals.resolved_reason: [G4 sweep] conditional-unmet: ClickHouse Cloud live tests explicitly gated on cloud credentials becoming available; no open item indicates credentials are now provisioned.

deferrals.reason: LakeSail requires the proprietary Sail server binary. No public Docker image exists. Live testing requires manual setup with a Sail server license. The stub (w3) provides CI coverage for adapter wiring.
deferrals.resolved_reason: [G4 sweep] conditional-unmet: LakeSail live Docker test requires a proprietary licensed Sail server binary BenchBox doesn't have; the CI stub already covers adapter wiring.

preserves.behavior: All live tests must skip gracefully when their service is unreachable - no hard failures in CI
Docker compose files must not require persistent state - use volumes that are cleaned up on down -v
Existing live tests (Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks) must not be modified
Existing stub-based smoke tests must continue to pass - live tests are additive, not replacement
run_smoke_benchmark() helper in common.py must remain backward compatible

work_units.summary: Docker compose files for 6 missing platforms
Makefile targets + pytest marker for Docker integration testing
Create LakeSail stub in common.py for CI coverage
Docker live tests: ClickHouse server + PostgreSQL
Cloud live tests: Redshift + Athena SQL
